description: This file defines the Salary class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for report display fields related to salary information in the HRM application. It extends another class to inherit display field behaviors and provides specific methods to return associated DTO class, entity aliases, and database fields.

classes.name: Salary
classes.description: Represents a display field for salary information in reports, extending ListableDisplayField and specifying the DTO class, entity aliases, and relevant fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) associated with this display field, specifically Dto\Salary.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides the entity alias used in database queries, here returning an array with 'salary'.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields this display field pertains to, in this case 'employee.empNumber'.
